name: fm1-violioliolol
author: Laurens Profittlich
tagline: Real-time physical modelling strings for the M-VAVE FM-1
description: fm1-violioliolol turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a physical-modelling string instrument: no samples, every note is a computed vibrating string. Nineteen instruments in four families: basses, guitars, bowed strings and folk strings (harp, mandolin, banjo, koto, zither). Plucked strings are Karplus-Strong waveguides with stiffness, pluck and pickup position and a modal body; bowed strings are a nonlinear stick-slip waveguide with bow pressure, speed, position and vibrato. Up to twelve voices, key velocity and pressure, MIDI control and sixteen user presets. Experimental.
